# Veloxis Global — Full Context & Service Catalog

Veloxis Global is an India-based, performance-first digital marketing agency and growth engineering firm. We specialize in building predictable customer acquisition pipelines by combining technical search engine optimization (SEO), high-ROAS paid advertising, and automated CRM workflows.

## 2. Core Methodology & Workflow

We execute a structured, 5-step growth workflow for all client campaigns:

1.  **Detailed Audit**: We perform deep audits of page speed, keyword mapping, analytics tracking accuracy, and past ad performance.
2.  **Funnel Design**: We build conversion-optimized landing pages and design lead-capture paths.
3.  **High-Performance Traffic**: We deploy targeted Google Search, PMax, and Meta ad campaigns to capture active buyer intent.
4.  **Sales Automation**: We connect n8n/Make automation to CRM portals and setup WhatsApp auto-replies for lead speed-to-lead response.
5.  **Scale & Optimize**: We monitor campaign data weekly and optimize creatives, bid strategies, and page speed parameters to maximize ROI.

## 3. Client Case Studies & Metrics

### Delhi Real Estate Developer
*   **Goal**: Scale organic lead generation for a luxury property developer.
*   **Results**:
    *   Scaled organic website traffic from 0 to 35,000+ monthly visits.
    *   Achieved a 5.2x return on ad spend (ROAS) on accompanying paid search campaigns.
    *   Dominating high-intent property keywords in Delhi NCR.
*   **Case Study URL**: https://veloxisglobal.com/case-studies/delhi-real-estate-developer

### Noida SkillEdge Academy
*   **Goal**: Reduce cost-per-lead (CPL) for professional training courses.
*   **Results**:
    *   Slashed PPC Cost-Per-Lead (CPL) by 42% within 60 days.
    *   Increased overall lead volume by 2.4x.
    *   Rebuilt Meta dynamic creative funnels and configured Google Search ads.
*   **Case Study URL**: https://veloxisglobal.com/case-studies/noida-edtech-lead-generation

### Lucknow Healthcare Brand
*   **Goal**: Drive local patient bookings for a multi-specialty clinic chain.
*   **Results**:
    *   Generated 500+ qualified patient leads within 90 days.
    *   Placed profile in the Google Maps top 3 local pack.
    *   Established automated WhatsApp Business review flows.
*   **Case Study URL**: https://veloxisglobal.com/case-studies/lucknow-healthcare-leads

### Kanpur Fabrics B2B
*   **Goal**: Drive export and domestic B2B inquiries for a textile manufacturer.
*   **Results**:
    *   B2B online inquiries scaled to account for 40% of all new business revenue.
    *   Ranked #1 for core national textile exporting keywords.
    *   Automated lead routing to sales representatives via CRM.
*   **Case Study URL**: https://veloxisglobal.com/case-studies/kanpur-fabrics-b2b
